## [1.1.0](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/compare/v1.0.5...v1.1.0) (2026-11-08)

### ✨ New Features

* swipe to add/remove on Recent and New episodes ([7b740aa](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/commit/7b740aa60bfce7763ae8e2c5ee44b8b6d2a02cac))

patches.name: Swipe to add/remove on new episodes
patches.description: On the New episodes screen, swipe an episode left or right to add it to the playlist, or to remove it if it is already there.

patches.name: Swipe to add/remove on recent episodes
patches.description: On the Recent episodes screen, swipe an episode left or right to add it to the playlist, or to remove it if it is already there.

patches.name: Swipe to remove from playlist
patches.description: Swipe an episode left or right in the Playlist to remove it from the playlist. Swiping between the Playlist tabs no longer works, tapping the tab titles does.
